# Waline client assets

Locally hosted official `@waline/client` **3.16.0**, downloaded from the npm registry on 2026-10-11. The npm tarball SHA-1 was checked against its registry metadata. These three files are unmodified: `waline.js`, `waline.css`, `LICENSE` (MIT).

- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@waline/client/-/client-3.16.0.tgz
- `waline.js` SHA-256: `c5d2d112c6b2764e8c2119bdfe8b9ff43a34f3b4c09b9265af69bb35e47a15a4`
- `waline.css` SHA-256: `f20cd01492b606dc399330717e3e28546ba2013eeb323461008db4a845382f09`
- `LICENSE` SHA-256: `a4cd42d0c11522c7debc3586e2301aad504df529921b89b79fc1331af0fe2b5f`

The generated website copies these assets only when Waline is enabled. Visitors do not need a client CDN. Image search, uploads, image emojis, TeX, CAPTCHA and OAuth are not enabled in the integration. Read the integration guide before changing these defaults.
